scientific_integrity: A complete all-parameter analytic proof accompanies diagnostic exact-rational verifier checks. Finite tests do not certify the infinite statement; residual literature-priority risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact monotonicity guarantee for only four symmetric knots, natural zero-second-derivative endpoints, and uniformly bounded positive secant slopes; no claim for longer/asymmetric grids, arbitrary contrast, or other spline conditions. Historical novelty is provisionally assessed from identified sources; no external expert review.
title: Sharp contrast-five monotonicity and unique optimal symmetric mesh for four-knot natural cubic splines
